content: गौण {%a.%} (णी|{%f.%}) [गुणमधिकृत्य प्रवृत्ता गौणी, तत आगतः अण्] .²1 Subordinate, secondary, unessential; गुणवचनत्वाद् गौणः शब्दः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 15</ls>. .²2 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Indirect or less immediate (<ab>opp.</ab> मुख्य or प्रधान); गौणे कर्मणि दुह्यादेः प्रधाने नीहृकृष्वहाम् <ls>Sk.</ls> .²3 Figurative, metaphorical, used in a secondary sense (as a word or sense); तदा गौणमनन्तस्य नामानन्तेति विश्रुतम् <ls>Mb. 12. 182. 33</ls>. .²4 Founded on some resemblance between the primary and secondary sense of a word; as in गौणीलक्षणा. .²5 Relating to enumeration or multiplication. .²6 Attributive.
